61/S0.subgoal: Explain how the Unity developer environment supports graphics-pipeline operations and what render-pipeline options it provides.

61/S1.subgoal: Describe how Unity's built-in render pipeline supports object definition through model files, meshes, materials, and textures.

61/S2.subgoal: Describe how Unity supports scene creation, lighting and visual effects, and view transformation in the built-in pipeline.

61/S3.subgoal: Explain how Unity implements the graphics pipeline through native graphics libraries and AutoGraphics API selection.

61/S4.subgoal: Explain how Unity's physics engine supports realistic motion using rigid bodies, colliders, joints, and articulation.

61/S5.subgoal: Explain how Unity supports animation and audio components for immersive XR experiences.

61/S6.subgoal: Summarize the main points of the lecture and preview scripting and SDK support.
